adjudication.evidence: Original N/E/U shows a sustained offset beginning near index 612 (N drops ~4 mm, E jumps ~18 mm, U drops ~5 mm) and persisting through index 654, with interior points (e.g., indices 616–644) showing stable elevated E (~17–18 mm) and depressed N/U, consistent with a temporary platform. P2 (616–644) is fully embedded in P1 and has much smaller onset offsets (e.g., E +0.77 mm vs +17.9 mm for P1), indicating it is not an independent event but part of the same platform. The return is evident after index 654: E drops back toward pre-offset levels (e.g., index 655 onward E ~11–13 mm, then ~10–12 mm), N recovers, and U rises—supporting a single genuine temporary platform from 612 to 654. No other independent temporary platforms exist in this interval.
